description: Updates come on the 1st and the 15th, grouped, and are merged once main's required checks pass, unless they raise a major version. release-please collects the fix(deps) ones in the release pull request, which is merged by hand.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes come at once, outside the schedule.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refreshes uv.lock, which pins the dev tools the tests and CI run; no release contains it.

customManagers.description: uv's version in pyproject.toml, which CI requires to equal the dev container's and the prek hook's.

packageRules.description: The library, in the manifest Home Assistant installs from and in pyproject.toml together: a test requires them to be equal. A new version reaches users, so it is a fix release-please releases.
The dev dependencies, which no release contains.

pytest-homeassistant-custom-component pins the Home Assistant release the tests run against, and with it the requirements of its modbus integration below. A new one goes on its own, so the modbus pins can follow by hand on the same branch when test_manifest asks for it.

The requirements of Home Assistant's modbus integration, at the versions the tested Home Assistant release installs. They follow pytest-homeassistant-custom-component, not their own releases (docs/design.md).
